items.name: Mixture of Agents (MoA)

items.remaining_gap: No multi-model consensus. Agent Teams = same model parallelism

items.name: Self-Learning Skill Creation
items.description: Agent autonomously creates SKILL.md from experience
items.absorption_plan: Hook SessionEnd → detect resolved task → generate SKILL.md draft → skill-validator → persist in squads/*/skills/
